title: [YSQL] Postgres crash on concurrent INSERT and SELECT
body:
Using commit 8efbb9b26bfd6ea795fb8957eb9f33392bee713a, when running the specific test involving two threads, one `INSERT`ing and one `SELECT`ing, it ends with `postgres` process segmentation fault crash.
Curiously enough, I wasn't able to reproduce this manually, and changing query `SELECT * FROM test_rr LIMIT 10` by dropping `LIMIT` or adding `ORDER BY` prevents catching this problem.

* Test reproducing the crash: https://gist.github.com/frozenspider/6b658d9de942ed30fee9e05c5d3bccec
* Test results: [test-results.zip](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/files/3797836/test-results.zip)
* Command I used to run the test: `./yb_build.sh --java-test org.yb.pgsql.TestPgReadRestarts2`
